EN:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Hello again, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}. Think this
snow will ever stop, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}?
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}¿Qué tal, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}? La cantidad
de nieve que se ha acumulado ya,
{{TAG:0005:0007:}}...
Ahora el pueblo está maravilloso,
pero cuando se derrita,{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}} va a
quedar todo hecho un desastre.
{{TAG:0003:000D:}}No puedo evitar preocuparme por
estas cosas, ¡qué quieres que te
diga!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}C'est encore toi, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}... Bien.
Tu as vu toute cette neige ? C'est
vraiment incroyable, {{TAG:0005:0007:}} !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Ciao di nuovo, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}.
Pensi che smetterà di nevicare
presto, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}?
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Yine merhaba, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}. Sence bu kar
hiç duracak mı, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}?

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}I'd swear you're not even bothered
by all this cold, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Oye, clavelito, {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}por el pueblo corre
el rumor de que eres medio
esquimal.
¿Es cierto? {{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}}Como parece que no
te afecte el frío, es normal que
todos lo piensen, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}On dirait que ce froid ne t'affecte
pas... Mais comment fais-tu pour
résister, {{TAG:0005:0007:}} ?!
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Sembra proprio che tutta questa
neve non ti faccia nemmeno
un baffo, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Man könnte fast meinen, diese
Eiseskälte mache dir gar nichts
aus, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Bütün bu soğuk seni hiç rahatsız etmiyor
diye yemin edebilirim, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}You know, all this snow looks so
pure, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}. It's a shame it'll
be walked all over, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}El color blanco de la nieve es
precioso. ¿No te parece,
{{TAG:0005:0008:}}?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:002B:}}¡Ojalá pudiera hacerme un vestido
de nieve, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Regarde cette neige, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}.
Elle est si belle, si blanche, si pure...
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Di nuovo ciao, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}. La neve
rilassa anche te, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}?
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Biliyor musun, bütün bu kar çok saf
görünüyor, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}. Üzerinde yürünüp
bozulacak olması yazık, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.

FR:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Re-bonjour, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} Tu sais,
c'est important de bien se nourrir
quand il fait froid comme ça.
Et rien ne vaut
{{TAG:000E:0002:}}{{TAG:0005:0013:0000}} pour
se réchauffer, {{TAG:0005:0007:}} !
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Yine merhaba, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}
Böyle soğuk bir günde biraz {{TAG:0005:0013:0000}} iyi giderdi.

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}No matter how I dress, I never seem
to be warm enough. {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}Hmm. {{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}Maybe
I'm cold blooded, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Por mucho que me abrigue, sigo
teniendo frío.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}¡A ver si tienen razón{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}} y resulta que
soy de sangre fría, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Même bien couverte,{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} j'ai encore
froid.{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}} En fait, {{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}}{{TAG:0003:001B:}}on m'a souvent dit
que je suis un peu froide...
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Ho cinque strati di vestiti, ed ho
ancora freddo. {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}Mmmh, {{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}forse mi sta
venendo la febbre, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Angeblich gibt es kein schlechtes
Wetter, {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}nur falsche Kleidung.{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} Wieso
ist mir trotzdem immer kalt?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Brrr!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Ne giyersem giyeyim yeterince
ısınamıyorum. {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}Hımm. {{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}Belki
de soğukkanlıyım, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}You know, this snow covers nearly
everything...{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}except all the junk we
leave lying around, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}La nieve lo cubre absolutamente
todo...{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} hasta las imperfecciones.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}No es el caso de nuestro hermoso
pueblo, claro está, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Comme tu le vois, la neige a presque
tout recouvert...{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} Presque tout sauf
les déchets, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}...
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Biliyor musun, bu kar neredeyse her şeyi
örtüyor...{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}ortalıkta bıraktığımız bütün
ıvır zıvır hariç, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
